question_set.question: Using find_extremes, what is the name of the smoking_status × alcohol_consumption cell that is highlighted as extreme and what is one broader pattern across the grid?

answer.value: (a) With find_extremes(top_n=1, mode=both) on mean vitamin_c_percent_rda, the tool highlights two cells: the global maximum mean is Former × Moderate (≈ 90.9 % RDA aggregated in the spec), and the global minimum mean is Never × Moderate (≈ 85.3 % RDA). (b) Broader pattern: mean vitamin C % RDA across smoking_status × alcohol_consumption stays in a narrow band (~85–91 on aggregate); Moderate alcohol appears at both highlighted extremes, while other alcohol levels show mid-range means—no steep gradient from “none” to “heavy” on this color scale alone.

key_insights: Extremes (min/max mean vitamin C) both fall in the Moderate alcohol column—Former vs Never smoking.
Overall grid contrast is modest: cell means cluster within a few percentage points of RDA.

reasoning_trace.rationale: quickly highlights the most significant data points. This allows us to identify broad patterns without a specific hypothesis
